data.name: Isaac
data.title: Son of Abraham
data.description: The son of promise born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age, and the second patriarch of Israel.
data.scripture_text: This is the account of the family of Isaac, the son of Abraham.

data.name: Jacob
data.title: Father of the Twelve Tribes
data.description: The son of Isaac who wrestled with God and was renamed Israel; he was the father of the twelve sons who became the tribes of Israel.
data.scripture_text: Then the other twin was born with his hand grasping Esau’s heel. So they named him Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.

data.name: Judah
data.title: Son of Jacob
data.description: The fourth son of Jacob and Leah, whose tribe was prophesied to hold the royal scepter of Israel.
data.scripture_text: Once again Leah became pregnant and gave birth to another son. She named him Judah, for she said, 'Now I will praise the Lord!' And then she stopped having children.

data.name: Perez
data.title: Son of Judah
data.description: The son of Judah and Tamar, through whom the lineage leading to King David was continued.
data.scripture_text: But then he pulled back his hand, and out came his brother! 'What!' the midwife exclaimed. 'How did you break out first?' So he was named Perez.

data.name: Hezron
data.title: Son of Perez
data.description: A grandson of Judah and head of the Hezronite clan who settled in Egypt with the family of Jacob.
data.scripture_text: This is the genealogical record of their ancestor Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron.

data.name: Ram
data.title: Son of Hezron
data.description: An ancestor of King David who lived during the time the Israelites were in Egypt.
data.scripture_text: Hezron was the father of Ram. Ram was the father of Amminadab.

data.name: Amminadab
data.title: Son of Ram
data.description: The father of Nahshon and an ancestor in the royal line of Judah.
data.scripture_text: Ram was the father of Amminadab.

data.name: Nahshon
data.title: Leader of Judah
data.description: The leader of the tribe of Judah during the Exodus and the wilderness wanderings.
data.scripture_text: Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.

data.name: Salmon
data.title: Son of Nahshon
data.description: The son of Nahshon who married Rahab and became the father of Boaz.
data.scripture_text: Nahshon was the father of Salmon.

data.name: Boaz
data.title: Kinsman-Redeemer
data.description: A wealthy and righteous man of Bethlehem who married Ruth the Moabite, serving as her kinsman-redeemer.
data.scripture_text: Salmon was the father of Boaz. Boaz was the father of Obed.

data.name: Obed
data.title: Son of Boaz and Ruth
data.description: The son of Boaz and Ruth, and the grandfather of King David.
data.scripture_text: Boaz was the father of Obed.

data.name: Jesse
data.title: Father of David
data.description: A farmer in Bethlehem and the father of eight sons, the youngest of whom was chosen to be king.
data.scripture_text: Obed was the father of Jesse. Jesse was the father of David.

data.name: David
data.title: King of Israel
data.description: The shepherd boy who defeated Goliath and was anointed by Samuel to become Israel's greatest king.
data.scripture_text: So as David stood there among his brothers, Samuel took the flask of olive oil he had brought and anointed David with the oil. And the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David from that day on.
